ATL AP Pickup Reference
Domestic Pickup — LN1 Level
From baggage claim → escalator down to lower level (LN1). Driver meets near lower level elevator between doors N2 and N3.
International Pickup — Concourse F
Domestic Terminal International Arrivals. After customs, follow signs to Ground Transportation. Driver waits at curbside pick-up area.
⚠️ Disregard Uber/Lyft rideshare signs
NWDA drivers park in short-term or cell phone lot. Text client when you arrive.

i
Uber, Lyft, or a private client outside the app — log it here so your income & mileage stay complete. Know the split? Add fare/tip/fee detail so your year-end report separates fares from tips instead of lumping it all together.
i
Tick nothing for the complete Year-End P&L — that's the one for taxes: cash basis, both mileage-deduction options, mapped to Schedule C. Tick a payment type and you get a business report instead — same detail, filtered, clearly marked as not for filing. Choose Excel (live formulas, unbranded) or a branded PDF.

👋 Welcome! Let's set you up

Why we need this: Your home address and vehicle info let the app calculate accurate mileage and trip costs for your rides. Your Venmo and payment options let clients pay you easily. You can change any of this later in your profile — this just gets you started fast.
Everyone starts with a shared temporary password. Set your own private one now, or keep the current one for now (you can change it later in your profile).
Used only to measure your drive distance for mileage & cost tracking. You can add it later.
MPG & gas price are only used to calculate your fuel cost on the income page. Skip them if you’re not tracking profit.

📲 Add NWDA to your home screen
This puts the NWDA icon on your phone so the app opens full-screen, just like a regular app.
🍎 iPhone & iPad (use Safari)
1
Open this page in Safari. (It won't work from Chrome or a link inside another app.)
2
Tap the Share button — at the bottom of the screen on iPhone (top-right on iPad).
3
Scroll down the share list and tap Add to Home Screen ⊞.
4
Tap Add in the top-right corner.
5
Close Safari and open the new NWDA icon from your home screen. Done!
🤖 Android (use Chrome)
1
Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right of Chrome.
2
Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app).
3
Tap Install / Add to confirm.
